grammar_card.title: 说'经常发生的事'(一般现在时)
grammar_card.intro: 本课讲一般现在时——表示经常/习惯做的事、客观真理。注意:主语是第三人称单数时动词加 -s/es;like/know/understand 这类表状态的词不用进行时。全用本课句子举例。

rows: 表经常/习惯:一般现在时
I paint a lot of pictures.
表客观真理:一般现在时
The earth goes round the sun.
like/know/understand 等状态词不用进行时
I understand what you mean.(不说 am understanding)

specialRules.rule: 对比:I am having breakfast(此刻正在)↔ I always get up late(经常)
specialRules.mark: 现在进行 vs 一般现在

specialRules.rule: whether = 是否,引导宾语从句:She tells me whether it is good.

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — Who is the student's best critic?

passage: I am an art student, and I paint a lot of pictures. Many people pretend that they understand modern art. They always tell you what a picture is 'about'. Of course, many pictures are not 'about' anything. They are just pretty patterns. We like them in the same way that we like pretty curtain material. I think that young children often appreciate modern pictures better than anyone else. They notice more. My sister is only seven, but she always tells me whether my pictures are good or not. She came into my room yesterday. 'What are you doing?' she asked. 'I'm hanging this picture on the wall,' I answered. 'It's a new one. Do you like it?' She looked at it critically for a moment. 'It's all right,' she said, 'but isn't it upside down?' I looked at it again. She was right! It was!

sentences.text_en: I am an art student, and I paint a lot of pictures.
sentences.text_cn: 我是个学艺术的学生,画了很多画。

sentences.text_en: Many people pretend that they understand modern art.
sentences.text_cn: 有很多人装成很懂现代艺术的样子。

sentences.text_en: They always tell you what a picture is 'about'. Of course, many pictures are not 'about' anything.
sentences.text_cn: 他们总是告诉你一幅画的'意思'是什么。当然,有很多画根本没什么'意思'。

sentences.text_en: They are just pretty patterns. We like them in the same way that we like pretty curtain material.
sentences.text_cn: 它们只是些好看的图案。我们喜欢它们,就像我们喜欢漂亮的窗帘布一样。

sentences.text_en: I think that young children often appreciate modern pictures better than anyone else. They notice more.
sentences.text_cn: 我觉得小孩子往往比任何人都更能欣赏现代绘画,他们观察到的东西更多。

sentences.text_en: My sister is only seven, but she always tells me whether my pictures are good or not.
sentences.text_cn: 我妹妹只有七岁,但她总能说出我的画是好还是坏。

sentences.text_en: She came into my room yesterday. 'What are you doing?' she asked.
sentences.text_cn: 昨天她到我房里来了。"你在干什么呢?"她问。

sentences.text_en: 'I'm hanging this picture on the wall,' I answered. 'It's a new one. Do you like it?'
sentences.text_cn: "我正把这幅画挂到墙上去,"我回答说,"这是幅新画,你喜欢吗?"

sentences.text_en: She looked at it critically for a moment. 'It's all right,' she said, 'but isn't it upside down?'
sentences.text_cn: 她用挑剔的目光看了一会儿。"还可以吧,"她说,"不过,是不是挂倒了?"

sentences.text_en: I looked at it again. She was right! It was!
sentences.text_cn: 我再次看了看画。她说对了!是挂倒了!

stage5.stem: 一般现在时常用来表示什么?
options: 经常发生的事 / 习惯性动作

stage5.stem: "I ___ a lot of pictures."(经常做:一般现在时)
"I ___ breakfast now."(此刻正在:现在进行时)
"Do you always ___ up so late?"(经常:一般现在时)
"此刻正在做"用现在进行时;"经常/习惯做"用:
"The earth ___ round the sun."(客观真理:一般现在时)
"The sun ___ in the east."(客观真理)
主语是第三人称单数(he/she/it)时,一般现在时的动词要:
"She always ___ me the truth."(她总是…真相:第三人称单数)
"My sister ___ modern art."(我妹妹…现代艺术:第三人称单数)
下面哪类动词一般不用进行时(-ing)?
options: 表状态的动词(like / know / understand 等)

stage5.stem: "I ___ what you mean."(表'明白',状态动词不用进行时)
"She ___ this song."(表'喜欢',不用进行时)
"I ___ you like classical music."(表'听说',一般现在时)
stage5.stem_cn: 我听说你喜欢古典音乐。

stage5.stem: "She tells me ___ my pictures are good."(是否)
stage5.stem_cn: 她告诉我我的画好不好。

stage5.stem: whether 引导宾语从句时,意思是:
"It's a new ___."(代替前面的名词 picture,避免重复)
